explanation: Root configuration changes for the HypoMap atlas build: package.json adds build:hypomap and test:hypomap-build, .gitignore excludes data/hypomap/source/ and data/hypomap/build/, hypomap-release.json pins the reproducible hypomap-atlas-2026-11-26 archive and manifest, and the Application workflow installs h5py, pandas and SciPy to run the synthetic-H5AD exporter test beside the service test. PROJECT_GUIDANCE lists the HypoMap source files among those not in the repository.
